effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon can't be returned to the hand or deck and it gets +3000 DP. Then, if [WarGrowlmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 10000 DP or less.
